name: mise
tagline: Dev tools, environment variables, and task runner in one CLI
description: mise is a unified CLI that combines dev tool version management, environment variables, and a task runner into a single tool. It replaces the need for separate version managers and task runners, keeping your project tooling consistent and reproducible. Built in Rust and a trending project of the week, it enjoys sponsorship from 37signals and is positioned as a modern alternative for developers who want one tool to manage their dev environment.
highlights: Combines dev tool versions, env vars, and task running in one CLI
Built in Rust with sponsorship from 37signals
One of the trending Rust projects of the week
curatorNote: Dev setup is usually a pile of separate tools; mise consolidates versions, env, and tasks into one fast CLI. It is a strong candidate for anyone tired of juggling multiple dotfiles and managers.
